name: China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation
zh: 中国航天科工集团有限公司

evidence.summary: SASTIND lists CASIC among China’s defence-industry group companies (军工集团). CASIC describes itself as the main force in building China’s defence weapons and equipment and as the developer and producer of the full range of China’s missile weapon systems, with complete systems for air and space defence, cruise and ballistic missiles.

CASIC describes itself as a key state-owned enterprise administered directly by the central government; it traces its origins to the Ministry of National Defense’s Fifth Academy, founded in 1956, and has 23 second-tier units.
